children: TruGolf founder Chris Jones has resigned as chief executive.
Board Chair Brenner Adams will succeed Jones as interim chief executive while the virtual golfing company looks for a permanent replacement.
The board also named Jay Heller as a new director, replacing Jones's spot on the board. Heller is chief executive of K lab, a company building programmable payments for institutional money movement.
He also has 18 years of leadership experience at Nasdaq, where he was head of capital markets and IPO execution.
Jones founded TruGolf as a subsidiary of Access Software before it spun off as an independent company in 2006.
